name: Started from a client brief

mapBrief.text:
# Northgate Library — Digital Membership Renewal

## Background

Northgate Library District serves 41,000 cardholders across six branches and a
bookmobile. Membership is free but must be renewed every two years, which is a
state requirement tied to proof of residence rather than a policy we chose.
Renewal is currently done in person at a service desk. In FY24 we processed
9,180 renewals and lost an estimated 3,400 cardholders who simply let their
membership lapse rather than make the trip.

## Who this is for

Our cardholders are not a homogenous group and the renewal problem does not
fall on them evenly. Roughly 30% of active cardholders are over 65. About
5,600 households in the district have no fixed broadband connection. Four of
our six branches are in neighbourhoods where the median household income is
below the county median. Any solution that assumes a smartphone, a printer, or
a credit card on file will exclude the people who use the library most.

## What we think we need

A cardholder should be able to renew from a browser without visiting a branch.
They should be able to do it on behalf of the other cards in their household.
Staff should be able to see what was renewed and by whom, and should be able
to intervene when an automated check fails rather than the cardholder hitting
a dead end.

## Residency verification

This is the part we are least sure about. State rules require proof that the
cardholder still lives in the district. Today a staff member looks at a
utility bill or a lease. We do not know what the digital equivalent is, and we
are not comfortable asking people to upload a photograph of a bill to a system
we would then have to secure and retain.

## Constraints

Our ILS is SirsiDynix Symphony, currently on-premises, upgraded last in 2022.
The vendor offers a renewal module we have not evaluated. We have one
half-time developer and no dedicated designer. The board's funding decision is
made in March and anything not costed by February will not be in that cycle.

## What success looks like

Fewer lapsed memberships, shorter desk queues, and no cardholder who could
renew in person before finding they cannot renew now. We would rather ship
something narrow that works for everyone than something complete that works
for the people who already find us easy to use.

## Out of scope

New card signups. Fine payment. Anything touching the catalogue or holds.

description: A map whose source is a twenty-page spec rather than a sentence, mid-deconstruction. The root pill carries the brief's own heading instead of a 57-character slice, and the agent has put the document's real gaps on the map as open questions. The brief now sits beside the map as a third pane: four of its seven countable sections are accounted for, the three nobody has touched carry the ink while the covered ones recede, and the title section - a heading with nothing under it - counts in neither half. Nodes derived from a section name it in their eyebrow, so a claim can be traced back to the passage that produced it.
